concept.subject: A garden path under a long white wrought-iron pergola, its arches standing one behind the other and receding toward a bright opening, with greenery and pale blossoms around them.
concept.composition: The front arch fills the picture: its broad white rails rise from legs near both edges and meet above the top edge a little right of center, the innermost rail cresting just under the top. Behind it a slender second arch stands with its legs at a quarter and three quarters of the width and its crown at a fifth of the height; the arches beyond shrink toward a bright opening a little right of center at half the height, their crowns crossing in a gray canopy under the top center. A path of round stepping stones runs from the bottom center up to the opening between bushes, and pale blossoms fill the top left corner outside the arch.
concept.layout: 60 round pegs and 72 bricks. The front arch's outer and inner rails and the second arch are three nested brick arches whose tops end at the cannon's clearance and whose legs stand down into the bushes, with narrow channels between them. Their inner faces are slides from the cannon: a nearly level shot to the left rides the outer rail down the left side, and a shot about 70 degrees to the right rides the inner rail down the right side. A short piece of the canopy, a peaked solid, hangs over the crown of the third arch; the third and fourth arches are peg arcs over the path, and the far opening, the stepping stones, the bushes on both sides, the thin far legs on the left and the greenery between the front and second arches' legs are pegs.

difficulty.note: Middle of the stage: the two rail slides light a run of bricks from one shot, but about eight of the twenty orange pegs fall on the third and fourth arches under the cannon, and the peaked canopy over the third arch's crown turns the straightest shots away from them.

background.prompt: A photo of a garden path under a long white wrought-iron pergola, seen along the path. The front arch fills the picture: two pairs of broad white rails, joined by scrollwork, rise from legs near the left edge (at about 0.05 and 0.12 of the width) and near the right edge (at about 0.85 and 0.95) and curve over to meet above the top edge a little right of center; the innermost rail crests at about a tenth of the height. Behind it a slender second arch stands with its legs at about a quarter and three quarters of the width and its crown at about a fifth of the height. The arches beyond shrink one behind the other toward a bright opening at about 0.6 of the width and half the height, their crowns crossing in a dense gray canopy under the top center. A path of round gray stepping stones runs from the bottom center, about 0.45 to 0.7 of the width, up to the opening; green bushes line both sides of it, pale blossoms fill the top left corner outside the arch, and the lower corners are dark greenery and the front legs' scrollwork.

picture.title: A scenic garden path under a decorative metal pergola surrounded by lush greenery.
